experiences.title: Senior Data Scientist
experiences.summary: Leads production demand forecasting for 30,000 products across 300 stores with LightGBM and a PyTorch deep learning model, designed the pricing experimentation platform running 50 A/B tests a quarter, and presents results to category heads. Python, SQL and Spark on AWS EMR daily.

Present forecast accuracy and experiment results to category heads.
